title: Analysis: 795 accounts funded by ADI Predictstreet's own fee-collecting wallet drove 99% of the FIFA-partnered prediction market's activity since late August (Wall Street Journal)
summary: Wall Street Journal: Analysis: 795 accounts funded by ADI Predictstreet's own fee-collecting wallet drove 99% of the FIFA-partnered prediction market's activity since late August — ADI Predictstreet, backed by Abu Dhabi's royal family, paid close to $150 million for advertising rights during the World Cup
